title: Public, staff and admin areas with a staff guide
summary: MyAPES Account now has three clear areas: Public, Staff and Admin. Staff, volunteers and students get their own staff guide alongside the public Help page.
changes: Add a staff guide for staff, volunteers, students and administrators, linked from the Support menu.
The public Help page points signed-in staff to the staff guide.
Confirm that signed-out visitors only reach public pages, staff land on the staff dashboard, and only administrators can switch to Admin.
version_rationale: Minor: starts the v0.47 public, staff and admin areas epic with a new staff guide page.
validation: New feature test for the three areas, the staff guide and the admin switch.
known_limitations: The staff guide covers the basics; admin help pages follow in a later release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.47.4 Beta, issue #464 under epic #463, pull request #592.
